structured.feedback: The description is about 165 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the slightly short length, the loose feature/benefit split, and "morning meetings to evening plans", which stretches the 4-5 hour skin longevity.
